summary: Implemented the localized Login and OTP request/verification surfaces for AUTH-01, AUTH-04, and AUTH-05 using the existing authentication contracts. Added safe validation, server-driven cooldown, retry/error states, OTP focus behavior, token-safe navigation, responsive styling, Vitest coverage, and a 36-test Playwright matrix across Arabic/English/Simplified Chinese and desktop/tablet/mobile.

scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx was changed as an explicitly authorized necessity exception because the existing route shell did not mount the selected AuthPage implementation; no unrelated product feature was added.

AUTH-04 is labeled OTP in the design manifest and route map, while the checked-in AUTH-04 export visually resembles the later registration form. The implementation uses AUTH-04 as the OTP request state and AUTH-05 as the OTP entry state, and intentionally leaves account creation to frontend_021 rather than inventing behavior.
Playwright API responses are test-only route fixtures; they are not production mocks or runtime data sources.
No Backend truth repair, dependency, contract, OpenAPI, Postman, or database change was required for this task.
knownGaps: The AUTH-04 local export/manifest semantic mismatch remains documented for the onboarding task boundary; no safe product behavior was inferred from the conflicting visual content.
